title: Gson finds parsed numeric keys in a map
summary: Equal boxed and parsed numbers missed a HashMap lookup on the parent and retrieved the saved value on the merge. Signed-zero replacement and removal used a single entry.

change.description: Gson makes equal numeric primitives backed by different Java number types hash consistently.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
